overview: Safford AZ PD uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Safford AZ PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Safford AZ PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Safford AZ PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy:
Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.
SOC 2 Type II

more_info.Homicide Suspect: With assistance from flock cameras, a wanted homicide suspect was detected passing through the area in 2024. Officers from several agencies worked together and were able to stop the suspect ending in an officer-involved shooting in another jurisdiction.  Based on the obtained information from the flock cameras agencies had time to create a tactical plan and bring the situation to a resolution where no members of the public or law enforcement were injured.
more_info.Sex Offender: Child molestation case.  The suspect vehicle was provided and entered into the flock system.  The vehicle was seen leaving town soon after the crime was discovered.  An alert was placed through the system to notify officers if it returned.  Later in the day officers were alerted it was coming back into town.  A stop was made and the suspect was taken into custody without incident.
more_info.Burglary/Stolen Vehicle: In July of 2026 two male suspects were arrested on multiple felony charges relating the burglary of a rental property, stolen vehicle, unlawful flight from law enforcement, and misconduct involving weapons.  This incident stemmed from a burglary of a short-term vacation rental home where the vehicle of the tenant was stolen along with her personal belongings inside the residence.   The vehicle was entered into Flock system as stolen in the morning.  Later in the day the vehicle was located by flock cameras in Thatcher area and pursuit was initiated by other agencies.  Ultimately the suspects crashed the vehicle and fled on foot before being taken into custody.  Both have prior felony charges as well.
more_info.Silver Alerts:
82 year old man with dementia located safely in Thatcher 2 days after leaving Phoenix.
77 year old man with dementia missing from Gilbert located safely in the area.
